paragraphs: From Newcastle West test centre on Sheehan's Road, drive to the end of the road and turn right onto Gortboy
Continue along Gortboy and take the next left into Kilcolman Drive, where you will practice a quiet estate loop
Follow the road as it bends right and then left, and be ready to perform a controlled turnabout (U-turn) on Kilcolman Drive when instructed
After the turnabout, retrace your route through Kilcolman Drive, keeping right and then left as the road bends, and turn left back onto Gortboy
Follow Gortboy to the end and turn right onto the N21
At The Old Pike Roundabout take the slight left exit, then at the next roundabout take the left exit onto Rathina
Continue along Rathina turn left into Beechwood Gardens
Take the slight right onto Beechwood Avenue and then turn right into Meadow Court, where the examiner may ask you to complete a reverse or turnabout manoeuvre
Perform a U-turn on Meadow Court and drive back out
At the end of Meadow Court turn left onto Beechwood Avenue
Take the next left onto Rathina at the end of the road turn left onto Saint Ita's Road
Turn right onto Bridge Street follow Bridge Street with a slight left as it bends
Turn right into The Square keep left through The Square, which becomes Church Street and then Churchtown Road
Continue along Churchtown Road turn right onto Station Road and follow it through the built-up area, watching your speed and observations at junctions
To return toward the test centre turn right off Station Road onto Gortboy
Take the next left into Sheehan's Road, which brings you back to the Newcastle West test centre to finish the route
